budget_items.topic: Municipal Building project trade cost estimates
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The design team gave trade cost estimates for the Meeting House, Ritter Memorial Building, Town Hall and site work, totalling a little more than $13M.
With contingencies and escalation the project reached about $15.3M, and with general contractors, insurance and overhead about $17.8M.
budget_items.quote: general contractors, insurance and overhead brings it to about $17.8m.

budget_items.topic: Municipal Building project total with Owner Project Manager
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Adding an Owner Project Manager at 15 to 20% brings the total project cost to a range of $21M to $22.3M.
budget_items.quote: bring the total project cost to somewhere between $21m and $22.3m
